entries.note: The shipment is booked; the event names the station that booked it.
The trucker who will deliver the shipment is told it is coming, here before the freight left its origin. It says nothing of where the freight is.
Loaded on the flight at the origin station, minutes before its departure.
A flight leg's departure from the station the event names.
A flight leg's arrival at the station the event names, at a transfer as well as at the destination.
Import clearance began at the destination.
Import clearance is done; delivery to the door follows.
The shipment page's last status, which can come without an event of its own.
